senses.gloss: --the chief of the third वातस्कन्ध, situated between the sun and the moon. Br. III. 5. ८४; वा. ६७. ११६.
--Four kinds of marriage mentioned: कालक्रीता, क्रयक्रीता, पितृदत्ता, स्वयम्युता। The first is वेश्या, the second is दासिका, the third is पत्नी, and the fourth गान्- धर्व। Br. IV. १५. 4.
--marriage dowry sent by Duryodhana as his daughter's marriage with साम्ब was approved. Vi. V. ३५. ३८.
